summary: Rocket One Inc. filed Amendment No. 2 to its prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5), registering up to $6,829,000 of common stock for sale at-the-market through H.C. Wainwright Co. under a Sales Agreement dated November 8, 2024. The filing increases the amount available for sale; previously, 8,124,155 shares were sold for ~$9.27 million gross. Shares trade on Nasdaq under RKTO at $2.22 as of June 2, 2026. No special-situation event is triggered; it is a routine equity shelf takedown to meet capital needs. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural changes are provided.
